During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] had a '''bounty''' place on their head. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] tracked the Quarren to a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], where he captured the bounty alive, restraining them at [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]-point. The Quarren was [[Color/Legends|orange]]-skinned with green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and dressed in a white shirt with black pants and waistcoat.<ref name="Fett" />
